teacher_info.teaching_style:
All classes are customized to student needs. However, the basic structure is as follows:

For writing classes, we will spend the time editing a writing sample you provide (prompts and questions can be given). We will review grammar, spelling, cohesion, vocabulary and structure.

For pronunciation, we cover four key concepts needed for a natural accent in American English: placement, pitch, breath, and weak consonants. We take a pronunciation test to find the specific areas of strength and focus before moving to sentence-level structures (intonation, linking, stress, reductions). Our long-term goal: to listen to native speakers, identify what techniques they use, and copy them ourselves.

exp_info.job: English as a Second Language Teacher
exp_info.description: Over the past 18 months, I have gained invaluable experience in teaching English as a Second Language online. I have taught over 600 lessons to students of all ages and abilities, including small children, students learning English for work, students learning English to live in America, and much more. I have developed a unique method for optimal learning, which includes a mixture of conversational and structured practice, with lessons designed specifically for each student.

As the owner of my own online store on Teachers Pay Teachers, I create, develop, and sell digital printable educational resources to teachers around the globe. One of my store's specializations is ESL/EFL resources and lesson plans.

Working as an Environmental Education Intern at Lums Pond State Park, I had the opportunity to educate people of all ages and backgrounds on the beautiful nature surrounding them. I helped run a large variety of educational programs, covering topics such as animal species found in the pond, tree identification, monarch butterfly habitat/migration/conservation, kayaking tours, and much more. I helped people find their passion for the natural world around them.

While pursuing my degree in Zoo Keeping Technology, I completed 700 hours of volunteering in the Education Department at Cheyenne Mountain Zoo. In my role as a Junior Zoo Keeper, I spent much of my time speaking and presenting to Zoo guests, educating them about our animals. I gave talks to groups of all sizes and ages about our animals' care, their anatomy, and our Zoo's role in conservation.

I spent three summers as a volunteer at my local library. I was a part of multiple library programs during my time there, including: Summer Reading Program, Reading Buddies (reading books with young children), and general library duties.

While attending Colorado Springs Early Colleges, I was chosen to be part of our school's National Honor Society. This prestigious group was in charge of carrying out service projects in our community, such as food drives for the homeless.

In my final year of middle school, I was chosen to be part of a program called WEB "Where Everybody Belongs". In this program, I helped 6th graders have a smooth transition into middle school. Our WEB group (all 8th graders) spent time with the kids during their first week of school and checked in on them throughout the year. We helped them do homework, talked to them about their transition, showed them around the campus, and led them in some fun games to help them get to know each other.

teacher_info.introduction: Hello everyone! My name is Amanda and I live in the great state of South Carolina where we're known for our Southern hospitality, Southern cuisine and Southern accents. I would love to have the opportunity to teach you English! I've been teaching English online since September 2015 and it's been a very rewarding experience. I've been able to see my students progress from beginning levels to intermediate and advanced levels and I've also been able to form meaningful relationships with them. I recently graduated from college with a B.A. in Spanish and a concentration in education. Spanish is my second language (yes, you guessed correctly!) and so I completely understand the ups and downs that come with learning a language. When I am not teaching English, I am teaching Spanish to adolescents as I'm also a middle school teacher. My methodology of teaching is through meaningful conversations that are centered around topics that matter to my students. I combine this meaningful conversation with cultural exchange because I believe that understanding the culture behind the language you are learning is just as important as language acquisition. I also provide my students with extra practice outside of the lessons such as watching videos, doing listening exercises and listening to music because I believe that being exposed to native input is the next best thing after communicating with native speakers. I hope to see you on the other side of my computer screen soon! I can't wait for us to begin this language learning journey together!

pro_course_detail.title: The Best Way to Learn Spanish! — Learn Spanish through Comprehensible Input and Interaction!
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Hola a todos!

Are you ready to learn Spanish through Comprehensible Input? I mean really acquire, understand and produce the Spanish language at your own pace? Well these are the lessons for you! Whether you are have a little experience, some experience or absolutely no experience with the Spanish language, this approach will help you acquire Spanish in a fun and meaningful way. 

What is Comprehensible Input (C.I.) anyway? Comprehensible Input simply refers to words and phrases that you can understand in another language through reading and/or listening at any given moment. I teach using solely this method so that you don't have to worry about boring textbooks, memorizing grammar rules or vocabulary lists or any of the painfully ineffective teaching methods you experienced in high school or college. 

Each class will be specially designed to suit your needs. During these classes we will focus on all four language skills (reading, writing, listening, speaking). I will provide all of the materials for you each class. There will be articles, photo/video description activities, songs and song lyric activities, writing activities, games and much more! 

These lessons are recommended for students who really want to be immersed into the Spanish language and the culture surrounding it. 

So, are you ready to start your Spanish journey and enjoy every moment of it? Book a class and experience a Spanish class that you've always wanted, but never knew existed!

¡Nos vemos pronto! 
(See you soon!)

Are you desirous of improving your accent in order to become more understandable to others? Would you like to sound more like a native English speaker from the United States?

This course is for you!

I will take you step by step through the basic sounds, vowels, and consonants that make up the American accent. Not only will your accent improve with time, but you will learn a lot about why the American accent sounds the way that it does. 

You will also learn about regional variances in the American accent like California, New York, the Midwest etc.

The only requirements for taking this course are the following:

1. You are mentally prepared to receive corrections. Sometimes receiving corrections can feel uncomfortable at first. However, if you remember that these corrections are to help you improve, you will achieve your goals.

By actively participating in these lessons, you will be making important steps towards improving your American English pronunciation skills. I will give you useful corrections during and after our lessons so that you can improve gradually. 

Give accent coaching a try. Your future self will thank you!

We will work on all modals of the language (speaking, listening, reading, writing, and pronunciation) through a mix of activities from discussing an article or video to practicing a new grammar point. Every lesson will be tailored to your individual goals and needs. The main benefit of iTalki is the opportunity to speak with a native speaker! Therefore, all lessons will have a focus on speaking and conversation. Reading and writing assignments will be assigned as homework and reviewed at the next lesson.  
Book a trial lesson today, and we will discuss your level and goals and create a plan for your lessons! You can message me for more information about my curriculum or any other specific questions you have.

✨ Evidence-based teaching approach using Communicative Language Teaching methods. 

✨ Attention to all beginner students! This General English course will be much more helpful than an Informal Tutoring lesson for beginner students. I highly recommend this structured course for beginning your language journey. Message me with any questions!

✨ Some Business English lessons are also available. Let me know if you're interested!

⚠️ CANCELLATION POLICY: You must cancel or reschedule your lesson at least 24 hours in advance. Cancellations and no-shows within less than 24 hours of the lesson time will NOT receive a refund. Thank you for understanding.

teacher_info.teaching_style:

Since I’ve taught every style of class, we can also do whatever style is best for the student, from a freer to a more regimented style. I believe that it is important to be flexible and help you in whatever way will make you be successful.
